description: Built a nightly ETL pipeline in Python and Airflow that loaded 2M+ order records from 6 vendor feeds into PostgreSQL, cutting the manual reconciliation work for the finance team from 5 hours to 20 minutes per week

Modeled 9 dbt tables for revenue reporting with tests on keys and freshness, replacing 3 spreadsheet exports and giving analysts one documented source for weekly sales and refund numbers across the finance team

Added 85 pytest data-quality tests and a GitHub Actions check that blocked schema drift before deploys, catching 12 bad vendor files in the first month without a single failed production load in the nightly pipeline

Trained a PyTorch image classifier on 18K labeled warehouse photos to flag damaged pallets, reaching 93% accuracy on a held-out set of 2K images and replacing a manual check done each week by 3 lab members

Wrote a FastAPI service that served model predictions to 4 robot controllers over REST, holding p95 latency under 120ms on one GPU by batching incoming requests and caching repeated camera frames in Redis

Tracked 60 training runs in MLflow with fixed seeds and versioned datasets, so that a 4-person team could reproduce any reported result from its run ID in under 10 minutes instead of retraining the PyTorch model

Shipped 11 React and TypeScript screens for a patient scheduling tool used by staff at 30 clinics, working from Figma designs and closing 46 tickets across 6 sprints of 2 weeks each as part of a team of 5 engineers

Fixed a double-booking bug in the Node.js scheduling API by adding a PostgreSQL unique constraint and a retry path, removing about 15 duplicate appointments per week that clinic staff had reported across 30 clinics

Raised unit test coverage on the booking module from 48% to 81% with Jest and Playwright, which caught 7 regressions in code review before they reached the staging environment used by the team of 5 engineers

personalProjects.name: TrailCast
description: Launched a trail-conditions API that merges 3 public weather feeds and 1.2K ranger reports into one PostgreSQL database, serving 900 weekly requests from a Python and FastAPI backend on a single $7 server

Cut average response time from 480ms to 95ms by caching forecast lookups in Redis with a 15-minute expiry, measured across 10K replayed requests taken from production access logs of the FastAPI service and its PostgreSQL database

Automated deploys with Docker and a GitHub Actions pipeline that ran 140 pytest tests on every push, taking a release from 12 manual steps down to 1 merged pull request for the whole PostgreSQL and Redis stack

personalProjects.name: DocSearch
description: Created a retrieval tool in Python over 4K pages of course notes using LangChain and pgvector, answering study questions with links to the source page in about 3 seconds per query on a PostgreSQL and pgvector backend

Improved answer relevance from 0.52 to 0.71 MRR on 150 labeled questions by combining PostgreSQL full-text search with vector search in pgvector and reranking the top 20 results before they reached the model

Reduced OpenAI API spend 64% by caching embeddings for unchanged pages and sending only the 5 closest passages to the model, tracked over 2K logged queries from the course notes retrieval tool built on LangChain

personalProjects.name: QueueWatch
description: Deployed a Go job runner to Kubernetes on GCP with Terraform, scaling workers on queue depth and processing 80K jobs per day across 3 node pools during load tests of the full Prometheus and Grafana setup

Instrumented the runner with Prometheus metrics and 4 Grafana dashboards, which traced a memory leak to an unclosed channel in the Go worker loop and cut pod restarts from 22 per day to 0 during load tests

Enforced graceful shutdown with a 30-second drain window on Kubernetes, so that 500 in-flight jobs finished during rolling updates with no lost or repeated work across all 3 node pools on GCP during load tests

personalProjects.name: LedgerLite
description: Developed a budgeting web app in React and TypeScript with a GraphQL API on Node.js, supporting 5 account types and importing 3K bank transactions from CSV files in under 2 seconds on a PostgreSQL database
Designed a PostgreSQL schema of 9 tables with row-level checks on every transfer, so that 250 generated test ledgers balanced to the cent after 50K random transactions run through the Jest test suite
Covered the import and reconciliation paths with 120 Jest tests, which exposed 6 rounding defects in currency conversion before the first public release of the React and Node.js budgeting app
